summary: Official Baofeng UV-5RX CPS 20231124 (baofengradio.com download page; ZIP SHA-256 4848128a68dcb0d2ddfa54c65ad43591718d8e9e3b62112691ff6cd60926590a; Inno 5.5.7 -> BF_5R_ThreeBand.exe .NET).
